question: Which of the following is an example of a Western coast port?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kandla port**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kandla i**s an **example of a Western coast port in India**
 
• Kandla** is a seaport in the Kutch District of Gujara**t, near the city of Gandhidham.
 
• It is Built in the 1950s, **Kandla replaced the Karachi port on the western coast.**
 
• Kandla's main imports include crude oil, petroleum products, fertilizers, sulfur, and phosphate.
 
• Kandla's** main exports include food grains, naphtha, cotton, salt, and sugar.**
 
• Kandla is a tidal port and a Free Trade Zone.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Western Coastal Plains is a narrow strip of coastal plain between the west coast of India and the Western Ghats hills. 
 
• The western coastal plains are an example of the submerged coastal plain it is well known as the Coast of Submergence. 
 
• The western coast is more indented than the eastern coast, also the sea is deeper in the west coast than sea on the east coast and it provides natural conditions for the development of ports and harbours. 
 
• Ports like Kandla, Mazagaon, JLN port, Nhava Sheva, Marmagao, Mangalore, Cochin are located along the west coast.
